# @three-ws/agentcore-payments-mcp

> Platform-managed agent payment sessions — create a budget, pay any x402 endpoint without holding a private key. Governed by spend limits, URL allowlists, and per-tx ceilings. The agent proposes spend; three.ws governance enforces policy.

@three-ws/agentcore-payments-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/agentcore-payments-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/agentcore-payments-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/agentcore-payments-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/agentcore-payments-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/agentcore-payments-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
